title: Make the call!
html:
Good morning,

People think life is going to happen for them.

That the right opportunity will come along. Someone will call. Something will happen.

But what if it doesn't?

I remember sitting in a room with a group of people discussing what we could do with a customer.

While everyone was talking, I looked out the window and saw the customer getting into his car to leave.

So I got up, ran downstairs and caught him before he drove out the driveway.

I brought him back in.

$3k+ in sales for being slightly puffed.

We could have kept talking about what to do. Instead, I did something. And the customer was stoked.

MondayMotivator

If you're waiting for life to happen for you, life is happening to you.

Make the call. Send the message. Be dynamic! Take action.

Prompt for the week

What's one thing you've been waiting to happen that you could make happen yourself this week?

To your success!

Glenn "The Consistent Cash Man" Edley
